title: Register for and pay payroll tax
what: Register with the state revenue office and pay payroll tax once wages paid in Australia pass the state's threshold.

laws.title: Taxation Administration (Amounts and Rates—Payroll Tax) Determination 2026

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 2011 (ACT)
sources.quote: (2) The employer must apply for registration as an employer under this Act. (3) The application for registration must be made to the commissioner within 7 days after the end of the month.

triggers.unit: AUD of taxable wages a financial year (annual threshold)
triggers.note: Registration is triggered month by month, when wages pass the monthly or weekly equivalent; groups share one threshold.

sources.title: Taxation Administration (Amounts and Rates—Payroll Tax) Determination 2026
sources.quote: (a) The annual threshold amount for the purposes of schedule 1 of the Act is $1 750 000.

reach.note: Every employer, by taxable wages; exemptions (e.g. some charities) are not yet recorded.

confidence_note: The threshold is set by determination under the Taxation Administration Act 1999 (ACT), s 139; DI2026-151 lowered it from $2 million from 1 July 2026.
